pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to Daniel: what it is, how it works, key components, and how to get started. Links to all major subsections.

pages.title: Getting Started & Configuration
pages.purpose: Setup instructions, environment variables, the interactive setup script, and runtime configuration options (Claude vs Codex, model selection, billing modes).

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: The dispatcher/worker split, system map, data flow from iMessage through the interaction agent to workers, and how Convex ties everything together.

pages.title: Core Agent System
pages.purpose: Overview of the three-layer agent architecture: the interaction agent (dispatcher), execution workers, and the coding bridge. Links to child pages for each layer.

pages.title: Interaction Agent (Dispatcher)
pages.purpose: Deep dive into server/interaction-agent.ts: how it routes messages, its tool surface (memory, spawn_agent, spawn_coding_agent, automations, drafts, self-tools), the Daniel voice prompt, and the acknowledgment pattern.

pages.title: Execution Agent (Worker)
pages.purpose: How spawnExecutionAgent works, tool loading (Composio, browser, WebSearch/WebFetch), the draft staging safety pattern, agent lifecycle (cancel/retry), and usage logging.

pages.title: Coding Agent & Workspace
pages.purpose: The coding bridge: spawnCodingAgent, workspace lifecycle (plan/build/debug modes), Codex profiles, pending input Q&A flow, response styles, and workspace path management.

pages.title: Runtime Adapters (Claude & Codex)
pages.purpose: How server/runtimes/ abstracts Claude Agent SDK and Codex app-server behind a common runAgentRuntime interface, including sandbox policies, collaboration modes, and the codex-app-server-protocol.

pages.title: Memory System
pages.purpose: Overview of Daniel's SuperMemory-only architecture: identity isolation, fail-open context hydration, durable conversation capture, exact operations, and primary-owner pairing. Links to child pages for each subsystem.

pages.title: Memory Identity & Exact Operations
pages.purpose: Opaque sender isolation, salt-fingerprint validation, recovery-required behavior, local primary-owner pairing, and the recall/remember_memory/update_memory/forget_memory/remember_image tools.

pages.title: SuperMemory Context & Search
pages.purpose: How the server-only SuperMemory adapter hydrates static and dynamic profile facts, performs bounded semantic search, and fails open when the provider is unavailable.

pages.title: Durable Memory Capture
pages.purpose: The sole conversation_turn outbox contract, atomic assistant persistence, idempotency, retries, fencing, submitted-state recovery, dead letters, and recovery journal.

pages.title: iMessage Transport & Image Handling
pages.purpose: Overview of how messages flow in and out via Photon Spectrum, and how images are ingested, validated, stored, and cleaned up. Links to child pages.

pages.title: Photon Spectrum Bridge
pages.purpose: How server/imessage.ts connects to Photon Spectrum SDK, message deduplication, markdown stripping, chunking for iMessage limits, E.164 phone normalization, and the sendImessage function.

pages.title: Image Ingestion & Storage
pages.purpose: MIME type validation, size limits, Convex storage upload, content-block construction for multimodal prompts, image retention policy, and the cleanup loop.

pages.title: Integrations & External Tools
pages.purpose: Overview of how Daniel connects to external services via Composio, the local browser, and the integration registry. Links to child pages.

pages.title: Composio Integration Registry
pages.purpose: The IntegrationModule registry, how Composio toolkits are loaded and registered, multi-account handling, OAuth flows (managed vs BYO), identity extraction, and the composio-routes HTTP API.

pages.title: Proactive Email & Webhook System
pages.purpose: How Composio webhooks are registered and verified (HMAC), the Gmail trigger pipeline, email classification, warmup-skip logic, and the ensureProactiveWatcher startup flow.

pages.title: Local Browser Automation
pages.purpose: Patchright-based Chrome automation: launcher lifecycle, login handoff, accessibility snapshots, screenshot rotation, the browser REST API, MCP tools, and local-only security controls.

pages.title: Automations & Proactive Workflows
pages.purpose: Cron-based recurring task scheduling, timezone-aware execution, the automation polling loop, agent spawning for automation runs, and the create/list/toggle/delete tool surface.

pages.title: Automation Scheduling & Execution
pages.purpose: How automations are stored in Convex, the tickAutomations polling loop, nextRunFor cron evaluation, runAutomation lifecycle (create run → spawn agent → update run → reschedule), and SMS notifications.

pages.title: Draft Staging & Safety Controls
pages.purpose: The draft-before-send pattern: save_draft (staging), list_drafts/send_draft/reject_draft (decision), how the interaction agent commits external actions, and the Convex drafts table schema.

pages.title: Persistence Layer (Convex)
pages.purpose: Overview of the Convex database schema, all tables, indexes, and how the server interacts with Convex for state management. Links to child pages.

pages.title: Database Schema & Tables
pages.purpose: All Convex tables: application data plus the six SuperMemory support tables for the conversation outbox, provider state, pending exact operations, image anchors, metrics, and events.

pages.title: Usage Tracking & Cost Accounting
pages.purpose: The usageRecords table, how dispatcher, execution, proactive, and coding LLM calls log tokens and cost, and the billingMode (api vs codex-subscription) distinction.

pages.title: Operations Dashboard
pages.purpose: The React/Vite debug dashboard: panels for agents, SuperMemory profiles/search/documents/history/sync, automations, connections, events, local owner pairing, settings, and the changelog drawer. WebSocket live updates.

pages.title: Dashboard Panels & Components
pages.purpose: Each panel in the debug UI: DashboardPanel, AgentsPanel, MemoryPanel, MemorySyncPanel, AutomationsPanel, ConnectionsPanel, EventsPanel, SettingsPanel pairing controls, and ChangelogDrawer.

pages.title: Real-time Events & Broadcast
pages.purpose: The WebSocket broadcast system (server/broadcast.ts), agent and automation event types, and how the dashboard subscribes via useSocket.

pages.title: Skills & Agent Toolkits
pages.purpose: Overview of the .agents/skills and skills/ directories: reusable skill definitions for Convex patterns, the photon-spectrum skill injected into coding workspaces, and the upgrade-daniel skill.

pages.title: Photon Spectrum Skill
pages.purpose: The photon-spectrum skill injected into every coding workspace: references (spectrum-basics, webhook-patterns, photon-llms), templates (basic-webhook, convex-handler, nextjs-api-route), and the fetch-photon-docs script.
